prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Select Your Pet Path", "Choose between ready companion pets or create your own custom pet from photos."]
1: []
2: ["Choose How You Want to Adopt", "Pick an instant companion pet or design a unique custom pet from your own photos.", "Explore Paths"]
3: ["Sync & Protect Your Pet", "Sign in to save your pet companion to the cloud and restore it anytime on any device."]
4: ["Signing in with your primary email restores your previously adopted pets instantly."]
5: ["Adopt Ready Companion or Create Custom Pet", "Select a ready-to-play companion for immediate launch, or upload photos to generate a unique desktop pet."]
6: ["Choose Your Desktop Friend", "Select the companion pet that best matches your desk style."]
7: ["Your pet is preparing for your desktop. You will be notified as soon as it is ready to dock."]
8: ["Your Companion is Ready on Desktop", "Use the tray menu or click your pet to interact, hide, or open companion controls."]
9: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Your companion pet is officially adopted and ready for setup."]
